title: Company B remote queue and durable review evidence
objective: Build Company B's independent GitHub Issue queue/lifecycle wrapper around the already validated authoritative Claude-led worker. The wrapper must consume only Company B namespaced tasks, serialize local execution, create Draft PRs only after PASS, and publish exact-head durable Codex review evidence without touching Company A state.
acceptance_criteria: Add scripts/company_b/company-b-queue-worker.ps1 as the only Company B remote queue consumer.

Add scripts/company_b/setup-company-b-github.ps1 that idempotently ensures only Company B lifecycle labels: company-b:queued, company-b:running, company-b:blocked, company-b:done, company-b:approval-required.
Queue discovery must use only the Company B queued label and must never consume agent:queued or any Company A lifecycle label.
Process at most one queued issue per invocation and use a Company B-only local mutex/lock so concurrent local invocations fail closed.
Task payload must be parsed from explicit COMPANY_B_TASK_SPEC_START/END markers in the Issue body, validated as B-TASK-NNN JSON, and materialized only under the Company B runtime namespace.
Invoke scripts/company_b/company-b-worker.ps1 with PushOnPass; do not duplicate Claude/Codex implementation logic in the queue wrapper.
On worker PASS, create or reuse a Draft PR for the exact company-b/task-* branch. Never merge it.
Before marking done, publish durable PR evidence containing the exact task head SHA, fixed-test PASS, and the independent Codex final review text/verdict from the Company B runtime.
Fail closed and mark company-b:blocked when the task payload, worker, PR creation, exact-head verification, or durable review evidence is missing/ambiguous.
Add docs/company-b/QUEUE_PROTOCOL.md documenting lifecycle, issue-body task format, isolation, recovery, and no-auto-merge policy.

Add tests/test_company_b_queue_contract.py with deterministic static contract tests covering B-only labels, one-task-per-run, mutex presence, Draft PR behavior, exact-head evidence markers, and absence of agent:queued consumption.
Existing pytest suite plus the new contract tests must pass.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
